title: Time Sync Repair
description: Diagnose Windows time drift and synchronization errors, resync only after approval, and verify final time service state.
starter_prompt: Troubleshoot wrong system time or time sync failures with approval before repair.

phases.prompt: Scope time drift/sync symptom and collect evidence before service or resync actions.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $systemRoot=$env:SystemRoot; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($systemRoot)){ throw 'SystemRoot is not set, so w32tm.exe cannot be resolved' }; $w32tm=Join-Path $systemRoot 'System32\w32tm.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $w32tm -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows tool not found: ' + $w32tm) }; function Section($n){ Write-Output ('== ' + $n + ' ==') }; Section 'Local time'; Get-Date; Section 'Time service'; try { Get-Service W32Time -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | Format-List } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] W32Time service query failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Section 'W32TM status'; & $w32tm /query /status 2>&1 | Out-String | Write-Output; Write-Output ('w32tm /query /status exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Section 'W32TM peers'; & $w32tm /query /peers 2>&1 | Out-String | Write-Output; Write-Output ('w32tm /query /peers exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Section 'Time events'; try { Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-Time-Service'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-14)} -MaxEvents 100 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,LevelDisplayName,Message | Format-List } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] Time-Service events unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

phases.prompt: Collect read-only time service, peer, status, and event evidence.
Analyze time sync evidence. Identify service stopped, no peers, domain policy, drift, network, or permission causes.
Ask for explicit approval before resyncing time or starting the time service. Offer restore point handling for service changes when appropriate.
phases.completion: Approval and restore point decision are recorded.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $systemRoot=$env:SystemRoot; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($systemRoot)){ throw 'SystemRoot is not set, so w32tm.exe cannot be resolved' }; $w32tm=Join-Path $systemRoot 'System32\w32tm.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $w32tm -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows repair tool not found: ' + $w32tm) }; $failures=@(); Write-Output 'Resyncing Windows time after approval.'; try { $service=Get-Service W32Time -ErrorAction Stop; if($service.Status -ne 'Running'){ Start-Service -Name W32Time -ErrorAction Stop }; Write-Output ('W32Time status: ' + (Get-Service W32Time).Status) } catch { $failures+=('Start-Service W32Time failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Output '== w32tm /resync /force =='; & $w32tm /resync /force; $resyncExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('w32tm /resync /force exit code: ' + $resyncExit); if($resyncExit -ne 0){ $failures+=('w32tm /resync /force exit ' + $resyncExit) }; Write-Output '== w32tm /query /status =='; & $w32tm /query /status; $statusExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('w32tm /query /status exit code: ' + $statusExit); if($statusExit -ne 0){ $failures+=('w32tm /query /status exit ' + $statusExit) }; if($failures.Count -gt 0){ throw ('Approved time resync failed: ' + ($failures -join '; ')) }; Write-Output 'Approved time resync completed.'

phases.prompt: Run only after the approval gate succeeded and the restore point offer. Start/resync Windows Time and capture output. Fail the phase when the service cannot be started or any w32tm command reports a non-zero exit code.
phases.completion: Service start and resync both reported success, or the phase failed with the exact failing step and exit code.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $systemRoot=$env:SystemRoot; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($systemRoot)){ throw 'SystemRoot is not set, so w32tm.exe cannot be resolved' }; $w32tm=Join-Path $systemRoot 'System32\w32tm.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $w32tm -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows tool not found: ' + $w32tm) }; Write-Output '== Local time =='; Get-Date; Write-Output '== Time service =='; try { Get-Service W32Time -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | Format-List } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] W32Time service query failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Output '== W32TM status =='; & $w32tm /query /status 2>&1 | Out-String | Write-Output; $statusExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('w32tm /query /status exit code: ' + $statusExit); if($statusExit -ne 0){ throw ('w32tm /query /status failed with exit code ' + $statusExit + ', so time sync state is not verified') }

phases.prompt: Verify local time, service state, and sync status after approved action.
Check that domain-managed time policy or network failures are disclosed and not over-repaired.

Create a technician and customer-ready handoff report with evidence, findings, actions/tools used, verification status, artifacts/logs, cleanup status, residual risk, and prioritized follow-up next actions.
Keep logs and reports. Remove only workflow-created scratch files.

acceptance_criteria: Time service and sync evidence are collected before repair.
Resync/start action runs only after approval.
Verification captures final time and sync status.
Final report includes evidence, actions, cleanup status, risks, and follow-up items.
